objective: Locate the catastrophic-forgetting source by separating trained MLP CQ3 from trained attention-output AFF3 while keeping every other runtime and evaluation choice fixed, then quantify both intermediate arms on the frozen CUTE-Quick-20 slice.

factorial_arms.name: cq3_mlp_q4_attention
factorial_arms.purpose: isolate all-layer trained MLP CQ3 with original Q4 attention projections

factorial_arms.name: q4_mlp_aff3_attention
factorial_arms.purpose: isolate all-layer trained attention-output AFF3 with original Q4 MLP projections

interpretation.cq3_fails_aff3_passes: MLP CQ3 is the primary collapse source; move to sensitivity-selected or higher-bit MLP layers while retaining AFF3
interpretation.cq3_passes_aff3_fails: AFF3 attention-output approximation is the primary collapse source; retain Q4 attention for sensitive layers
interpretation.both_pass_full_fails: cross-component error interaction dominates; search mixed layer schedules rather than either component alone
interpretation.both_fail: both approximations independently require sensitivity selection or stronger training

claim_boundary: This is a causal catastrophic-forgetting diagnosis using one semantic canary and CUTE-Quick-20 per arm. It is not a promoted model, full benchmark, throughput, energy, 100 tokens per second, or novelty result.
